blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippines has extended its 14-day visa-free entry privilege for Chinese nationals for another year, allowing them to visit the country for tourism and business until Jan. 15, 2028, the Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) announced on Monday.
